name: UploadThing File Uploads
description: Type-safe file uploads for full-stack TypeScript apps — drag-and-drop UI components and secure server-side handling.
postInstallNotes:
1. Mount the upload handler in your API: `app.use('/api/uploadthing', createRouteHandler({ router: uploadRouter }))`.
2. On the frontend, install `@uploadthing/react` and use the `<UploadButton>` or `<UploadDropzone>` component.
3. Generate the frontend types client with `npx uploadthing generate` after setting your `UPLOADTHING_TOKEN`.
